description: OpenCode plugin + MCP server + skill that runs an automated GitHub Copilot PR review loop: request review, wait deterministically via `gh run watch`, triage every comment, push fixes, reply, resolve, gated merge. Solves the silent-fail of github_request_c

detail.description_zh: OpenCode 插件 + MCP 服务器 + 运行自动化 GitHub Copilot PR 审查循环的技能：请求审查，通过 `gh run watch` 确定性等待，分类每条评论，推送修复，回复，解决，门控合并。解决了 github_request_c 的静默失败问题
